title: Truncate the subjects
summary: Long email subjects end in … and never push the time out of the row.
brief: Each row of the 320px inbox shows an avatar, the subject and the time.
Subjects stay on one line. A subject too long for the space ends in an ellipsis (…), and the time always stays visible at the right end of the row.
The subject takes all the space the avatar and time do not need.
hints: Three declarations make an ellipsis: keep the text on one line, clip what overflows, and draw … at the cut.
white-space: nowrap, overflow: hidden and text-overflow: ellipsis on .subject. flex: 1 lets it take the free space.
The time is still pushed out? A flex item will not shrink below its content by default. Add min-width: 0 to .subject.

children.text: Re: Re: Fwd: Updated agenda for Thursday’s planning meeting with the whole team
Your invoice INV-2026-10-0042 for October is now available to download

solutionNotes: An ellipsis needs text that is on one line (nowrap), clipped (overflow: hidden) and told how to end (text-overflow: ellipsis). In a flex row that is not enough: a flex item’s automatic minimum width is its content, here the whole unbroken subject, so it would push the time out. min-width: 0 lets the subject shrink, and then there is something to clip.
